How to copy & install

Gmail

  1. Open email-signature.html in a web browser (Chrome / Safari / Edge).
  2. Select the whole signature (click just above the logo and drag to the last line), then copy (Ctrl/Cmd + C).
  3. In Gmail: Settings → See all settings → General → Signature → Create new, paste, and Save Changes.
  4. Host gff-logo.png on a public URL and make sure the logo src points to it, otherwise the logo will not show for recipients.

Outlook

  1. Open email-signature.html in a browser and copy the rendered signature.
  2. New Outlook / Web: Settings → Mail → Compose and reply → paste into the signature box.
  3. Classic Outlook (Windows): File → Options → Mail → Signatures → New, then paste.
  4. Outlook uses Word rendering — the table layout and Tahoma Arabic are chosen for this. Keep the logo hosted online.

Apple Mail

  1. Mail → Settings → Signatures → create a signature, then paste the copied signature (uncheck “Always match my default message font”).

Files in this folder

  • email-signature.html — production, inline-CSS signature (copy this one).
  • email-signature.png / .jpg — image previews (JPG on white).
  • email-signature.pdf — A4 sheet for printing / sign-off.
  • email-signature.svg — editable vector version.
  • gff-logo.png — the official GFF full-color master logo.

To change the employee details edit ../src/email-signature-source.html and re-run python3 scripts/build_exports.py. See the project README for full brand notes.
